products.title: CHATELET AIR 2.0 | 18-inch Weekender Bag, Beige rose
products.body_html: Chatelet Air 2.0, a DELSEY PARIS icon, marks the brand’s 80th anniversary with limited-edition color Beige Rose – a refined beige-pink with golden details, reflecting warmth and strength. The Weekender is the perfect carry-on addition to your luggage collection, or for use as an everyday bag. This piece is made with elegant twill fabric that is recycled and coated with stain protection. Unzip the doctored opening for full visibility into the bag featuring a padded laptop sleeve, RFID pocket for protection, and removable water-resistant pouch. Also, use the bag from day to night by packing your extra pair of shoes or clothes in the separate bottom compartment.

products.body_html:
Crafted from recycled polyester with a water-repellent finish, this tote bag protects belongings from everyday splashes while retaining its shape over time.

Inside, a dedicated PC and tablet compartment protects electronic devices, while a bottle pocket and locking zipper pullers keep essentials neatly organized. Weighing just 1.3 lbs, it features a rear trolley sleeve that slides securely over luggage handles, as well as adjustable shoulder straps for versatile 2-in-1 carrying.

Designed for effortless upkeep and mobility, it includes a practical removable lining, an exterior bottle pocket, and a rear trolley sleeve that slides easily over rolling luggage.

HELIUM AERO | 21-Inch Front Pocket Expandable Carry-On Suitcase, Metal brushed
products.body_html:
The HELIUM AERO 21" Carry-On is a lightweight, durable spinner made from polycarbonate. It includes an expandable main compartment with two sections, divider, and tie-down straps to keep belongings secure. The front pocket has a padded sleeve for laptops up to 15.6" and extra zippered pockets for organization. A TSA-approved lock keeps your luggage safe while allowing inspections without damage. Soft handles and smooth spinner wheels make travel easy. Fits most overhead compartments and comes with a 10-year warranty.

Perfect For: The traveler who needs options and wants perfect color coordination.
